claim: The sample demo finds two of three sidecars for crop and denoise.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:sample-demo
sandbox: fresh browser context; bundled sample; assert two result records

claim: Download for Linux serves the release executable.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:linux-download
sandbox: production build; browser download; assert filename, ELF magic bytes, and nontrivial size

claim: Native downloads are available for Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64, and Windows x64.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:cross-platform-downloads
sandbox: production build; request each named download and assert its native executable signature

claim: The free audit recipe pack downloads 12 plain-text commands without an account.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:recipe-download
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert generated text download contains a documented combination query

claim: Selected browser-demo sidecars are parsed locally and never uploaded.
where: landing page demo and privacy page
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:browser-local
sandbox: fresh browser context; choose an in-memory XMP file; record every request; assert no external request

claim: The site has no analytics, advertising, account, or payment runtime requests.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:no-runtime-third-parties
sandbox: fresh production-browser context; record all root-page requests and assert they stay on the product origin

claim: The browser demo accepts XMP, representative DxO PhotoLab DOP, and PP3 sidecars.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:browser-sidecar-formats
sandbox: fresh demo route; upload XMP and PP3 inputs plus the bundled DxO PhotoLab DOP fixture; assert all three parse and render

claim: The site and demo work offline after the first visit.
where: landing page first-screen facts and privacy page
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; wait for service worker; go offline; open and reload demo, privacy, and terms; assert each route's own content

claim: The CLI indexes XMP, representative DxO PhotoLab DOP, and PP3 sidecars, normalises aliases and history boundaries, records malformed files, and does not read image pixels.
where: landing page facts, how-it-works section, and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-sidecar-search
sandbox: temporary archive with XMP and PP3 data, the bundled DxO PhotoLab DOP fixture, malformed XML, and a RAW marker; assert active/inactive corrections, warnings, matches, and marker absence

claim: The CLI does not modify source sidecars or make network requests while indexing, searching, and reporting.
where: privacy page, terms page, CLI help, and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:cli-private-read-only
sandbox: temporary copy of all bundled sidecar families; deny and log connect, DNS, and send calls with LD_PRELOAD; compare source bytes, modes, and modification times before and after index, find, and report

claim: The CLI writes machine-readable JSON and CSV plus a self-contained offline HTML report.
where: landing page CLI reference and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:cli-outputs
sandbox: fresh CLI demo directory; parse JSON summary; assert CSV schema and report with no external resource URLs

claim: CLI exit codes are 0 for success, 1 for I/O failures, 2 for invalid usage, and 3 for no matches.
where: landing page CLI reference and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:cli-contract
sandbox: fresh CLI demo directory; run success, missing-index, invalid-match, and no-match commands; assert exact codes

test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:mit-license
sandbox: production site and shipped repository license; assert visible MIT fact and MIT license text
